entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is VeloBot. How can I assist you today?
Finally! I've been trying to get through for ages. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I’m calling about order number VF789234.

Hello! Thank you for calling VeloFit support. I understand you're calling about order VF789234 and want to return a VeloBand Pulse. I'm happy to help. Can you confirm the name associated with the order?

Thank you, Ms. Miller. I see your order here. The return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the delivery date. I see the item was delivered on October 26th, and today is November 8th. That means it's been 13 days since delivery. Can you tell me why you are returning it past the return window?

That's ridiculous! Look, this VeloBand Pulse was a gift. My birthday was a couple of weeks ago. I didn’t open it until yesterday because I was traveling! I just got back from visiting my mother in the hospital. She was very sick.
I am so sorry to hear about your mother, Ms. Miller. I understand this must be a difficult time. And that you were traveling. It sounds very stressful.
It is! And now this! I saw something on your website crashed earlier. Maybe that's why I couldn't get through!

Yes, we did experience a brief technical issue on our website crashed earlier, and I apologize if that caused any inconvenience. However, the return window is automatically calculated based on the delivery date. Even with it being a gift. Unfortunately, the policy regarding the return window of 10 days from delivery is fairly standard and outlined in the fine print of our purchase agreement. I understand this isn't ideal.
Fine print?! Nobody reads that! I'm telling you, I just opened it yesterday! It's completely useless to me. I want my money back.

I understand your frustration, Ms. Miller. Let me see what I can do. Given the circumstances you've described – the VeloBand Pulse being a gift and the extenuating family situation you are in and the problems that you've encountered on our website – I'm going to make an exception this one time. I can process a full refund for you. Would you like me to proceed?
Yes! Please! Thank you so much! I appreciate it more than you know.

Okay, I've initiated the refund. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days. You don't need to return the VeloBand Pulse. You can donate it to a local charity, or perhaps keep it in case you change your mind later. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again for understanding. You've been a great help!
You're very welcome, Ms. Miller. We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a good day and I hope your mother recovers quickly!
